description: This Java class 'EcuStimulator' provides functionality to simulate and analyze engine control unit (ECU) parameters, including building data tables, adjusting RPM and voltage settings, performing measurements, and generating output files for engine tuning purposes.

classes.name: EcuStimulator
classes.description: Main class responsible for ECU stimulation, data collection, and table generation which mimics engine parameters for testing and tuning.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of EcuStimulator.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Provides the main UI panel containing controls and data visualizations.

methods.name: buildTable
methods.description: Generates a measurement table by iterating over RPM and engine load ranges, collecting data, and outputting CSV and C code files.

methods.name: getInputs
methods.description: Returns the user-configurable stimulation inputs used for table generation.

methods.name: createButton
methods.description: Creates a Swing JButton to trigger the 'buildTable' process asynchronously.

methods.name: waitForMultipleResults
methods.description: Collects multiple dwell and advance measurements asynchronously, utilizing engine time listeners and synchronization.
